passages.text: My son, do not forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments; for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
passages.sermon:
A father speaks to his son.
He gives his son advice.
He says, “Do not forget my teaching.”
He tells his son, “Keep my commandments in your heart.”
He explains the result.
He says, “My teaching and commandments will add days to your life.”
He says, “They will give you many years.”
He says, “They will bring you peace.”
passages.original: בְּ֭נִי תּוֹרָתִ֣י אַל־ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י יִצֹּ֥ר לִבֶּֽךָ׃ כִּ֤י אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים וּשְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּ֑ים וְ֝שָׁל֗וֹם יוֹסִ֥יפוּ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
passages.sermon:
Loving devotion is important.
Faithfulness is important.
Do not let loving devotion leave you.
Do not let faithfulness leave you.
Tie loving devotion and faithfulness around your neck.
Write loving devotion and faithfulness on the tablet of your heart.
passages.original: חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֗ת אַֽל־ יַעַ֫זְבֻ֥ךָ קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־ גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then you will find favor and high regard in the sight of God and man.
passages.sermon:
You will find favor.
You will gain high regard.
God will see your favor and high regard.
People will also see your favor and high regard.
passages.original: וּמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן וְשֵֽׂכֶל־ ט֑וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאָדָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Trust the LORD completely.
Use all your heart to trust Him.
Do not depend on your own understanding.
In every way you live, know the LORD.
Acknowledge Him in all you do.
He will make your paths straight.
He will guide your steps.
passages.original: בְּטַ֣ח אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְאֶל־ בִּֽ֝ינָתְךָ֗ אַל־ תִּשָּׁעֵֽן׃ בְּכָל־ דְּרָכֶ֥יךָ דָעֵ֑הוּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יְיַשֵּׁ֥ר אֹֽרְחֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
passages.sermon:
Do not think you are wise.
Do not trust your own wisdom.
Respect the LORD.
Turn away from evil.
passages.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֣י חָכָ֣ם בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ יְרָ֥א אֶת־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְס֣וּר מֵרָֽע׃

passages.text: This will bring healing to your body and refreshment to your bones.
passages.sermon: God gives healing to your body.\r\nGod brings refreshment to your bones.\r\nGod does this when you trust Him and follow His ways.
passages.original: רִ֭פְאוּת תְּהִ֣י לְשָׁרֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝שִׁקּ֗וּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your harvest; then your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
passages.sermon:
Honor the LORD.
Use your wealth to honor Him.
Give the first part of all your harvest to the LORD.
If you do this, your barns will be full.
Your barns will have plenty.
Your vats will overflow with new wine.
passages.original: כַּבֵּ֣ד אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מֵהוֹנֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מֵרֵאשִׁ֗ית כָּל־ תְּבוּאָתֶֽךָ׃ וְיִמָּלְא֣וּ אֲסָמֶ֣יךָ שָׂבָ֑ע וְ֝תִיר֗וֹשׁ יְקָבֶ֥יךָ יִפְרֹֽצוּ׃פ

passages.text: My son, do not reject the discipline of the LORD, and do not loathe His rebuke; for the LORD disciplines the one He loves, as does a father the son in whom he delights.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He gives discipline.
He gives rebuke.
My son, do not reject the LORD’s discipline.
Do not hate His rebuke.
The LORD loves His people.
He disciplines those He loves.
A father loves his son.
A father corrects the son he delights in.
The LORD corrects those He loves, just as a father corrects his beloved son.
passages.original: מוּסַ֣ר יְ֭הוָה בְּנִ֣י אַל־ תִּמְאָ֑ס וְאַל־ תָּ֝קֹ֗ץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּֽוֹ׃ כִּ֤י אֶ֥ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶאֱהַ֣ב יְהוָ֣ה יוֹכִ֑יחַ וּ֝כְאָ֗ב אֶת־ בֵּ֥ן יִרְצֶֽה׃

passages.text: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding, for she is more profitable than silver, and her gain is better than fine gold.
passages.sermon:
A man who finds wisdom is blessed.
A man who gains understanding is blessed.
Wisdom is more profitable than silver.
Wisdom’s gain is better than fine gold.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מָצָ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝אָדָ֗ם יָפִ֥יק תְּבוּנָֽה׃ כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב סַ֭חְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־ כָּ֑סֶף וּ֝מֵחָר֗וּץ תְּבוּאָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire compares with her.
passages.sermon: Wisdom is more precious than rubies.\r\nNothing you desire can compare with wisdom.
passages.original: יְקָ֣רָה הִ֭יא מִפְּנִיִּים וְכָל־ חֲ֝פָצֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִֽשְׁווּ־ בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
passages.sermon: Wisdom is the subject of this passage.\r\nWisdom holds long life in her right hand.\r\nWisdom holds riches and honor in her left hand.
passages.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ יָ֭מִים בִּֽימִינָ֑הּ בִּ֝שְׂמֹאולָ֗הּ עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָבֽוֹד׃

passages.text: All her ways are pleasant, and all her paths are peaceful.
passages.sermon:
Wisdom is the subject.
Wisdom has ways.
All the ways of wisdom are pleasant.
Wisdom has paths.
All the paths of wisdom are peaceful.
passages.original: דְּרָכֶ֥יהָ דַרְכֵי־ נֹ֑עַם וְֽכָל־ נְתִ֖יבוֹתֶ֣יהָ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her, and those who lay hold of her are blessed.
passages.sermon: Wisdom is like a tree of life.\r\nPeople who hold on to wisdom receive life.\r\nPeople who support wisdom are blessed.
passages.original: עֵץ־ חַיִּ֣ים הִ֭יא לַמַּחֲזִיקִ֣ים בָּ֑הּ וְֽתֹמְכֶ֥יהָ מְאֻשָּֽׁר׃פ

passages.text: The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is wise.
The LORD used wisdom to found the earth.
The LORD understands all things.
The LORD used understanding to establish the heavens.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּחָכְמָ֥ה יָֽסַד־ אָ֑רֶץ כּוֹנֵ֥ן שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם בִּתְבוּנָֽה׃

passages.text: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.
passages.sermon: God has great knowledge.\r\nGod used His knowledge to break open the deep waters.\r\nGod made the clouds drip with dew.
passages.original: בְּ֭דַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמ֣וֹת נִבְקָ֑עוּ וּ֝שְׁחָקִ֗ים יִרְעֲפוּ־ טָֽל׃

passages.text: My son, do not lose sight of this: Preserve sound judgment and discernment.
passages.sermon:
A father speaks to his son.
He gives advice.
He says, “My son, do not let these things leave your sight.”
He tells his son to keep sound judgment.
He tells his son to keep discernment.
passages.original: בְּ֭נִי אַל־ יָלֻ֣זוּ מֵעֵינֶ֑יךָ נְצֹ֥ר תֻּ֝שִׁיָּ֗ה וּמְזִמָּֽה׃

passages.text: They will be life to your soul and adornment to your neck.
passages.sermon: Sound judgment and discernment give life to your soul.\r\nThey bring beauty to your neck.\r\nThey make your life full and attractive.
passages.original: וְיִֽהְי֣וּ חַיִּ֣ים לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ וְ֝חֵ֗ן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.
passages.sermon: If you keep sound judgment and discernment, you will walk safely.\r\nYou will go on your way without fear.\r\nYour foot will not stumble.
passages.original: אָ֤ז תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לָבֶ֣טַח דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝רַגְלְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִגּֽוֹף׃

passages.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
passages.sermon:
God protects those who trust Him.
You will lie down.
You will not be afraid.
You will rest.
Your sleep will be sweet.
passages.original: אִם־ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב לֹֽא־ תִפְחָ֑ד וְ֝שָׁכַבְתָּ֗ וְֽעָרְבָ֥ה שְׁנָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Do not fear sudden danger or the ruin that overtakes the wicked, for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from the snare.
passages.sermon:
God protects those who trust Him.
Do not be afraid when danger comes suddenly.
Do not fear when disaster destroys the wicked.
The LORD will be your confidence.
He will keep your foot from being caught in a trap.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹ֑ם וּמִשֹּׁאַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים כִּ֣י תָבֹֽא׃ כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יִהְיֶ֣ה בְכִסְלֶ֑ךָ וְשָׁמַ֖ר רַגְלְךָ֣ מִלָּֽכֶד׃

passages.text: Do not withhold good from the deserving when it is within your power to act.
passages.sermon:
This teaching speaks to all people who have the ability to help others.
Do not keep good things from those who deserve them.
If you have the power to do good, do it.
Give help when you are able.
Do not hold back what is rightfully due to others.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּמְנַע־ ט֥וֹב מִבְּעָלָ֑יו בִּהְי֨וֹת לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶיךָ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: Do not tell your neighbor, “Come back tomorrow and I will provide”— when you already have the means.
passages.sermon:
Do not tell your neighbor to leave and return later.
Do not say, “Come back tomorrow and I will give it to you.”
If you already have what your neighbor needs, do not delay giving it.
Give help when it is in your power to do so.
passages.original: אַל־ תֹּ֘אמַ֤ר לְרֵעֶיךָ לֵ֣ךְ וָ֭שׁוּב וּמָחָ֥ר אֶתֵּ֗ן וְיֵ֣שׁ אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, for he trustfully dwells beside you.
passages.sermon:
A neighbor lives near you.
He trusts you.
Do not plan to harm your neighbor.
Do not think of doing evil to him.
passages.original: אַל־ תַּחֲרֹ֣שׁ עַל־ רֵעֲךָ֣ רָעָ֑ה וְהֽוּא־ יוֹשֵׁ֖ב לָבֶ֣טַח אִתָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Do not accuse a man without cause, when he has done you no harm.
passages.sermon:
Do not start a quarrel with a person for no reason.
Do not accuse someone if he has not harmed you.
Only act if there is a true cause.
Do not seek conflict when you have suffered no wrong.
passages.original: אַל־ תָּרוֹב עִם־ אָדָ֣ם חִנָּ֑ם אִם־ לֹ֖א גְמָלְךָ֣ רָעָֽה׃

passages.text: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways; for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
passages.sermon:
A violent man uses force to harm others.
Do not envy a violent man.
Do not choose any of his ways.
The LORD detests people who are perverse.
The LORD is a friend to people who are upright.
passages.original: אַל־ תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּאִ֣ישׁ חָמָ֑ס וְאַל־ תִּ֝בְחַ֗ר בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָֽיו׃ כִּ֤י תוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה נָל֑וֹז וְֽאֶת־ יְשָׁרִ֥ים סוֹדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.
passages.sermon: The LORD is God.\r\nThe LORD curses the house of the wicked.\r\nThe LORD blesses the home of the righteous.
passages.original: מְאֵרַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה בְּבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע וּנְוֵ֖ה צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְבָרֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: He mocks the mockers, but gives grace to the humble.
passages.sermon: God mocks those who mock others.\r\nGod gives grace to humble people.
passages.original: אִם־ לַלֵּצִ֥ים הֽוּא־ יָלִ֑יץ וְלַעֲנִיִּים יִתֶּן־ חֵֽן׃

passages.text: The wise will inherit honor, but fools are held up to shame.
passages.sermon: Wise people receive honor.\r\nFoolish people receive shame.
passages.original: כָּ֭בוֹד חֲכָמִ֣ים יִנְחָ֑לוּ וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מֵרִ֥ים קָלֽוֹן׃פ
